docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Dharmasūtras of Āpastamba and Gautama in Bühler’s translation: the oldest Indian law books, on the duties of the student, householder and king, on penance and inheritance.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The sacred laws of the Âryas as taught in the schools of Âpastamba, Gautama, Vâsishtha, and Baudhâyana · Bühler, Georg, 1837-1898, Apastamba, Gautama (Authority on Nyayasastra), Vasistha, Baudhayana · 1879-82, 412 scanned pages. Published 1879; Georg Bühler died 1898; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
